blocks.text: Sulfuric acid ko chemicals ka badshah kaha jata hai, aur us ka istemal kisi mulk ki sanati taraqqi ka pata deta hai.

items: Acid ka bara hissa fertilisers banane mein jata hai; aam taur par 77.67 feesad calcium phosphate Ca3(PO4)2 wale phosphate rock ko galata hai. Fluorapatite, Ca5(PO4)3F, se single superphosphate Ca(H2PO4)2 aur phosphoric acid H3PO4 banaye jate hain, jo double aur triple superphosphates aur ammonium phosphate ke liye istemal hota hai; acid ammonia se bhi react kar ke ammonium sulfate fertiliser deta hai.
Cu, Ni aur steel jaise ores se metals nikalna.
Oil aur coal refining aur polymer, synthetic rubber aur plastics ki sanaton mein catalyst.
Pulp aur paper ki sanat, aur pesticides, insecticides, herbicides, varnishes, dyes, dawaiyan, sabun aur detergents ki tayyari.
Trinitrotoluene (TNT), nitroglycerine, picric acid aur nitrocellulose jaise explosives ke liye nitration.
Khurak ki sanat, cheeni, starch aur corn syrup ke liye.
Paint ki sanat, titanium dioxide pigment ke liye.
Lead storage batteries (acid ka 35.67 feesad, print ke mutabiq).

blocks.text: Agarche yeh bohat si sanaton mein istemal hota hai, sulfuric acid aakhri product mein shaz-o-nadir hi hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Sulfuric acid ke istemal ko sanati taraqqi ka paimana kyun samjha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Taqreeban har manufacturing shobe mein yeh kahin na kahin istemal hota hai, fertilisers aur metals se le kar kaghaz, plastics, dyes, explosives, khurak ki processing aur batteries tak, agarche aakhri product mein shaz-o-nadir hi hota hai; to mulk mein jitni zyada sanat, utna zyada sulfuric acid kharch hota hai.

items: Chemicals ka badshah: fertilisers (phosphate rock se superphosphates aur H3PO4; ammonium sulfate), metal nikalna, refining aur polymers mein catalyst, kaghaz, pesticides, dyes, dawaiyan, detergents, explosives (TNT), cheeni aur starch, TiO2 pigment, gases sukhana, lead batteries, lab reagent; aakhri product mein shaz-o-nadir.
